Edit decision list

Definition

Edit decision list is a structured list of source and record timecodes describing a sequence of editorial events. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align post decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.
